hero.srTitle: Lumino, social, ads and customers for businesses.

about.body1Before: Whoever runs a business has no time to shoot reels, follow campaigns and answer messages. With us
about.body1After: : shooting, editing, publishing, ads and leads, with one person who always answers.
about.body2: We take on few clients at a time, because a profile that sells means understanding a trade before telling its story. We look at how you work, what you sell, who walks through the door. Then we show it to the right people, and we show you how many of them became customers.

services.lead: Social, ads and leads: all connected, with one point of contact. And when it’s needed, the website too.

steps.title: Content that stops the thumb
steps.body: The videomaker comes to you; we write, shoot and edit. Reels, carousels and stories published to a plan every week, with replies to comments and messages.

steps.title: Ads that find people who buy
steps.body: The best content becomes campaigns on Instagram, Facebook and Google, shown only to people who can really become your customers: area, age, interests, buying intent.

steps.title: Leads, not likes
steps.body: Every enquiry lands in a dashboard you can see too: who it is, which ad it came from, what it cost. Every month we cut what doesn’t pay and push what brings in money.

acts.shootSub: half a day, content for a month

sectors.lead: The trade changes, the method doesn’t. Every sector has its own way of being chosen: our job is working out what yours is.

items.name: Restaurants
items.body: The menu is the product: it has to be seen. Reels of the dishes shot in the room, ads to people who live nearby, and bookings that come straight to you with no middleman taking a cut.
builds: Dish reels shot on location
Ads to people who live and work nearby
Direct bookings on WhatsApp and the site
Google reviews that keep growing

items.name: Hotels
items.body: Every direct booking is a commission you don’t pay. Content that makes people want to travel, campaigns in the right months and enquiries that come to you, not to the portal.
builds: Content of rooms and experiences
Seasonal campaigns on Google and Meta
Direct bookings, no commissions
Reports on what each channel brings in

items.name: Companies
items.body: Whoever is looking for you is also weighing up three others. We make you the first one they find, say what you do in thirty seconds and put every enquiry in a dashboard your sales team can see too.
builds: Google campaigns on people searching for your service
A landing page for every offer
Qualified leads in a dashboard
Well-kept LinkedIn and social profiles

items.name: Retail
items.body: The physical shop and the online one are the same shop. Content that brings people in, ads to people passing nearby and promotions you can actually measure.
builds: Reels and stories of new arrivals
Local ads that bring people in-store
Campaigns for sale days
Customers who come back, not just new ones

items.name: Real estate
items.body: A property sells through its photos and through who sees them. Property videos, ads aimed at people who are really looking, and viewing requests that arrive before the competition’s.
builds: Property videos and photos
Ads to people searching in the area
Viewing requests in a dashboard
An agency profile that inspires trust
